title: OSF Director
description: A development fixture for the refined menu layout. These settings only change the preview.

settings.label: Auto-advance stages
settings.hint: Automatically move to the next stage when its duration ends. Turn this off to advance stages manually.

settings.label: Loop final stage
settings.hint: Keep the final stage playing until you choose to end the scene.

settings.label: Scene notifications
settings.hint: Show a brief notification when a scene starts or finishes.

settings.label: Lock movement
settings.hint: Keep the player in place while the scene is running.

settings.label: Smooth transitions
settings.hint: Blend between stages for a more natural transition.

settings.label: Restore view after playback
settings.hint: Return to your previous camera view when the scene ends.

settings.label: Free camera
settings.hint: Move the camera independently during playback.

settings.label: Hide HUD during scenes
settings.hint: Keep the scene clear of interface elements.

settings.label: Enable playback shortcuts
settings.hint: Use keyboard shortcuts to advance or end playback.

settings.label: Toggle playback key
settings.hint: Choose one keyboard key to toggle playback. This preview does not dispatch hotkeys.

settings.label: Advance stage key
settings.hint: A required binding; this setting cannot be cleared.

settings.label: Diagnostic logging
settings.hint: Include additional details in the log while troubleshooting a scene.

settings.label: Language
settings.hint: Use auto for Starfield's language, or enter a locale such as en, de, or pt-BR. This preview does not change OSF UI.
